scope: Four confirmed Legacy gameplay changes from the official Year of the Pegasus Core adjustment list. This is a bounded audit, not an assertion of complete historical coverage.

sources.evidence: Korean notes explicitly state card balance adjustments apply March 12, including Core balance changes, separately from the March 20 Core rotation.
Official Korean Core update links the card adjustment list.
Official Korean list specifies Big Game Hunter gains Tradeable; Mind Control Tech is targeted and costs 5; Twisting Nether also destroys locations; Ysera gives two Dream cards each turn.

EX1_005.correction: Move Tradeable text from 2021-03-26 to 2024-03-12, remove Tradeable from initial mechanics and add it at the real patch. Keep existing 2021 mana change.

EX1_085.correction: Move selectable-target text from 2021-03-26 to 2024-03-12 alongside existing 5-mana change.

EX1_312.correction: Move location-destruction effect from 2021-03-26 to 2024-03-12. Keep existing spell-school introduction.
